meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品链接或脚本自动转为宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作产品发布或推广视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create product launch or promotional videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能根据你提供的产品链接、脚本或简介，自动制作产品宣传视频。它会全程负责：捕捉素材、设计脚本、生成配音、构建画面，最终产出一个完整视频。
howto.when: 当你想要推广、发布或展示某个产品时触发。比如你给出产品网站链接或一段介绍文案，Claude就会启动视频制作流程。

say.text: 帮我根据这个产品页面做个宣传视频
say.note: Claude会捕捉网站并生成视频

say.text: 我有一段脚本，做成产品宣传片
say.note: 脚本将作为配音词使用

say.text: 为我的网站做一个展示视频
say.note: 会进行网站导览并制作展示

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to turn a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch/promo video. It orchestrates a workflow: setup, capture assets, design system, storyboard/script, audio, visual design, frame building, and final render, resulting in a complete video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product. Also for site tours/showcases. Usually invoked when a product URL or script is provided.

say_en.text: Make a promo video from this product page
say_en.note: Captures the site and generates video

say_en.text: I have a script, turn it into a product promo
Make a showcase video of my website
say_en.note: Conducts a site tour and creates video
